Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2023 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of JNJ.
We generated $5.3 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 21% to 22% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
